methodologyNotes: Official pricing pages were re-fetched and verified on 2026-06-18: katanamrp.com/pricing, mrpeasy.com/pricing, statii.co.uk/pricing, fishbowlinventory.com/pricing, gosteelhead.com/pricing, and fulcrumpro.com. Compliance verified from katanamrp.com/security, fishbowlinventory.com/security, and mrpeasy.com/blog/iso-27001-2022. Autodesk Fusion Operations (formerly Prodsmart) official page (autodesk.com/products/fusion-operations/overview) returned HTTP 403; the Capterra listing (capterra.com/p/153796/Fusion-Operations) cites $2,000/user/year as a starting price, but Autodesk directs buyers to authorized resellers and publishes no first-party price, so monthlyUsd is null (a null beats a guess). MRPeasy publishes EUR only (verified: 39/59/79/125 EUR per user/month, 'From the 11th user 69 EUR per 10 users'); USD equivalents ($49/$69/$99/$149) are corroborated by multiple third-party aggregators (Capterra, TrustRadius, CheckThat.ai, PulseSignal) and retained with provenance noted. Statii publishes GBP only (57.50 GBP / 8.50 GBP per user/month); no USD is published, so monthlyUsd is null rather than a converted guess. Fulcrum and Steelhead publish no prices (quote-only) and are kept at null. All accessedAt = 2026-06-18.
